# Third-party dependencies

`arcore/include/arcore_c_api.h` is the unmodified Google ARCore 1.48.0 C API header,
retrieved from the `v1.48.0` tag of google-ar/arcore-android-sdk. Its copyright and
ARCore Additional Terms of Service notice are preserved in the file. The ARCore
runtime and Java SDK are resolved from Google's Maven repository, not reimplemented.

Source: https://github.com/google-ar/arcore-android-sdk/blob/v1.48.0/libraries/include/arcore_c_api.h
Terms: https://developers.google.com/ar/develop/terms

GharMap is an independent implementation. It contains no CubiCasa code, assets,
models, training data, trademarks or private API integrations.
